campaign_scope.comparison: Matched reference origins only; added coverage separate. Everytarget/horizon/role/replica visible. No scalarwinner or automaticpromotion.
campaign_scope.numerical_claim_guard: Any claimed improvement must have complete matchedsupport, same gain sign in both replicas and replica mean discrepancy<20%ofpairedgain; this heuristic is numerical stability only, not confidence or significance.
campaign_scope.primary_use: 24-month return opportunity diagnostic; downside and12/48-month coordinates remain separate, no averaged utility.
campaign_scope.prior_exposure: Public BTC history and all earlier CDF/candidate results are exposed. This is a new baseline challenge, not an unseen holdout or fresh market significance test.
campaign_scope.stage: one development-only baseline-family run, no parameter/model tuning after results

model_protocol.edge_strip: outer2% of each coordinate interval; numerical proxy, not excluded-tail bound
model_protocol.entry: first innovation is next-day entry; then requested integer holding days
model_protocol.failure: FitError; no plug-in or pooled fallback
model_protocol.initial_history_variance: s^2 at start of trailing730-return window
model_protocol.interpretation: price-only model-based reconstruction, not calibrated or production-qualified
model_protocol.parameter_uncertainty: one joint(mu,s,h_next) draw per path, held across all days/horizons
model_protocol.posterior_coordinates: u=mu/s, y=log(s); prior includes Jacobian exp(y)
model_protocol.quadrature: tensor trapezoid;65^2 coarse; marginal1e-8 tails+4coarse-cell padding;local65,129,257 meshes

protocol.atom_range: generative outside_atom_range is a finite Monte Carlo sample-range diagnostic, not zero probability outside model support
protocol.brier_estimand: generative empirical Brier minus p*(1-p)/(n-1); reference issued CDF uncorrected
protocol.corrections: empirical scores and corrections retained; no clipping of corrected scores
protocol.crps_estimand: generative iid U-statistic uses n*(n-1) pair denominator; reference issued CDF exact uncorrected
protocol.entry: next calendar day; first simulated return updates state but is excluded from holding P&L
protocol.failure_policy: retain all eligible origins; withhold cell means if any forecast fails
protocol.intervals: inclusive central 50% and 80%; left inverse weighted empirical CDF
protocol.name: generative-price-scorecard-v2
